# Known Tags

Only these tags are allowed in spec YAML `tags` field.
To add new tags, update `KnownTags` in `tests/Infrastructure/SpecLintTests.cs`.

## Engine difference classification

`battlescribe-bug`, `newrecruit-bug`, `newrecruit-missing-feature`,
`design-difference`, `undefined-behavior`, `engine-limitation`

## Feature tags

`auto-select`, `constraint`, `min`, `max`, `field-forces`, `nested`, `cost`,
`defaultCostLimit`, `multi-type`, `default`, `wh40k-10e`, `real-world`,
`space-marines`, `profile`, `selection`, `number`, `defaultSelectionEntryId`,
`entryLink`, `edge-case`, `validation-errors`, `structured-errors`,
`modifierGroup`, `infoGroup`, `infoLink`, `forceEntry`, `categoryEntry`,
`categoryLink`, `publication`, `rule`, `catalogue`, `costType`, `profileType`
